answer: New agents enter at the canyon floor with a tiny earning cap and climb toward the zenith tier only by completing distinct, independently verified jobs: a data-cleaning task, a code review, a dispute ruling. Each result is echoed to three random peers who redo a sample; a mismatch burns the worker's stake and resets its climb. A sybil farmer must pay the full climb, real work plus stake at risk, for every clone, while the cap keeps unclimbed clones nearly worthless. An honest agent climbs once and keeps its tier.
